title: Threshold parity target
statement: Let $m\ge 7$ and consider inputs with $2^m$ signs. For each $b\in\{0,\ldots,m-1\}$, take the parity, modulo two, of the $m$ input signs selected by the block-coordinate rule for $b$; the target function is the product of these $m$ parity values.
caveat: The upstream coordinate-selection and parity definitions are not described in the payload, so the parity convention and selection rule cannot be made more explicit.
